title: SO-A-04 Relationship model and change propagation: milestones, deliverables and work packages as store entities, explicit links from scope to tasks, artifacts and evidence, stale marking on change and provenance on every projection
request: Build layer of the Scope One programme, adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026 (fold id SO-A-04) and validated against memev main at d1c65ef. Contracts marked with a dagger are signed in the owner's vault and are not visible in this repository; they are cited by id only. Implements the design record SO-1.07 (Relationship model: explicit relations between project items, and change propagation that marks affected work stale) (contracts/scope-one/specs). The decision record cites this contract by id and keeps only the gaps this one does not cover. Builds on signed vault contracts: SO-02-A†, SO-05-C†, SO-05-D†, SO-07-A†, SO-C-C†. Memev contracts that land first: SO-1.01. Source in the fold: #222 recommendation 7 (factual, interdependent model; propagate changes; derive progress; provenance and freshness). Settled decisions this contract follows (owner decision 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/DECISIONS.md): topology is local-first and the cloud is only a relay and a backup; every supported provider stands on equal footing and no work or tier depends on one; crdt-merge is reached only through the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs (docs/EXTENSION-POINTS.md) and this contract adds no merge engine to the core; tiers follow docs/PRICING.md (Free core, Personal for up to 3 computers with no per-computer add-on, higher tiers by contacting us) with no Personal trial; the git backup keeps running every few minutes (sync.interval_min). Memory authority: ADR 7 (memory and project-state authority) is proposed in PR #325 and is not decided here; this contract cites it and the local-first decision, and keeps one store under the vault with no second database. Provenance: adapted from the unsigned fold of 30 Oct 2026. Changes: (1) converted from the vault task format to the memev spec format (named tests run as red-green checks on the own test file of the contract; inline regular expression flags became the flags key; hygiene and decision verifiers became commands or doc checks). (2) removed fold-only fields and the owner-decision marker field, reworded the stop rule that named a patent, and made the text pass the leak scan. (3) Prerequisite SO-1.01 added. Entities are added to the one project store by extending the validator list in place (ADR 1: store schema version and migration), with no second store. (4) Boundary note: PG-10.1 WP10-04 (as-of query) reads versions the model here records; it does not restate them.

tasks.title: Relationship model and change propagation: milestones, deliverables and work packages as store entities, explicit links from scope to tasks, artifacts and evidence, stale marking on change and provena
requirements: the store gains validators for the entity kinds milestone, deliverable and work package, each with a stable id (the SO-07-A AC06 list extended), and
a change to a requirement or scope version emits stale markers on every dependent plan, task, artifact, approval and evidence record
every projection carries, beyond the provenance fields of SO-05-D AC07 and SO-05-C AC03, the source event id, time, scope and plan version and
progress derives from milestones, work packages and completion criteria
docs/PROJECTS.md carries a relationship section that explains the stale marker and re-acceptance
tasks.description: The addendum (recommendation 7) makes the workspace a factual, interdependent model: every view is a projection of the store, relationships are explicit, a changed requirement marks dependent plans, tasks, artifacts, approvals and evidence stale, and progress derives from defined milestones, never from an agent's percentage. SO-07-A AC06 validates project, task, lease, attempt, evidence, event, conflict, integration session and approval; milestones, deliverables and work packages are brief sections today (SO-02-A AC01). This contract adds them as entities, the link types as events, the impact listing, provenance and freshness beyond SO-05-D AC07 and SO-05-C AC03, and the derivation rule for progress.

criteria.statement: the store gains validators for the entity kinds milestone, deliverable and work package, each with a stable id (the SO-07-A AC06 list extended), and the link types scope-to-milestone, milestone-to-plan, milestone-to-deliverable, deliverable-to-work-package, work-package-to-task, task-to-dependency, task-to-artifact, task-to-check, task-to-evidence, blocker-to-work and permission-to-resource are stored as events with stable ids and validated against docs/schemas/relationships-v1.json

criteria.statement: a change to a requirement or scope version emits stale markers on every dependent plan, task, artifact, approval and evidence record; memev work impact <id> lists them with the reason, and the markers clear only by a new verification or an explicit re-acceptance event

criteria.statement: Every changed file is inside this contract's scope

stop_rules: Stop and post BLOCKED when a criterion cannot pass without weakening a test, skipping a test or relaxing an assertion.
Stop and ask when the work would name a client product, a person, a server or a seat in repository text; the client names live in docs/CLIENTS.md only.
Stop when the work would add a runtime dependency, a model call, a network call at install or start, a second store for project state, or any reporting that is not opt-in and off by default.
Stop when the work would move convergence logic into the core, vendor the engine, or add a merge engine beside the provider boundary of src/engine/merge.mjs.
If any criterion fails after the fix: STOP, report the measured result, the failing check and file:line. Do not start the next task.
If the work needs a path outside scope: STOP and ask the owner to amend the contract. Never widen scope silently.
